I am writing to express my disappointment and frustration with the treatment and care provided by Dr. Swati for my wife's fibroid issue. 3. Long leave without proper care*: Dr. Swati went on a long leave for her daughter's wedding, leaving us with limited support and care during a critical period. Doctors should definitely go on long leave, but then should also avoid complex surgeries before going in such leaves. We were left with some assistant doctors number.

## Comparison with the Second Doctor
In contrast, the second doctor we consulted was fantastic. They were available for all our queries, charged less compared to Dr. Swati, and did not charge for follow-up visits. My wife is now fully recovered after the second surgery.

## Conclusion
Based on our experience, I would not recommend Dr. Swati for fibroid treatment. Her lack of availability, uncooperative behavior, and additional charges for procedures made the experience quite frustrating. We hope that Dr. Swati will take our feedback constructively and improve her services.
